_comment: Pro edition overlay for the large drive: built with scripts/build-drive.sh --pro on top of config.json. Cloud models send the chat to their company and need the user's API key (Settings -> Cloud AI).

models.name: ☁️ Claude Sonnet 5.5 (cloud, Anthropic: faster, lower cost)
☁️ Claude Haiku 5.5 (cloud, Anthropic: fastest, lowest cost)

apps.name: Camofox Browser
apps.description: A private web browser your agents can drive: they open pages, read them, click and type. It is built on Camoufox, a Firefox that websites block less often than automated Chrome. Each computer type downloads its own browser once (about 1.3 GB).

apps.name: HyperFrames video maker
apps.description: Turns HTML into MP4 videos. Agents with the 🎬 Make videos tool write a short animated scene and HyperFrames renders it into your workspace folder. Includes its own Chrome and FFmpeg (about 600 MB per computer type).

apps.name: Claude Ads
apps.description: A paid-advertising skill pack: audits, plans and reports for Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat and X ads, with 250+ weighted checks. Agents with the 📚 skill tools (or the Ads Auditor template) read its instructions and work from the ad-account exports you add to Files. Works best with a ☁️ Claude model.

apps.name: Vibe-Trading
apps.description: A trading research agent from HKU: describe a strategy in plain words and it researches markets, writes and backtests it, and can run it on practice (shadow) accounts. Opens in your browser. It uses your Claude or OpenAI key from Settings → Cloud AI, or else the AI model running on this drive, and reads free public market data online. GANG AI sets up no broker or exchange account; only connect one inside Vibe-Trading if you really mean to trade real money. About 0.9 GB per computer type.
